neighbours.label: An adjective or intensifier right after 'some' or 'quelques' (some very, some great, some different)
fire: We saw some very old churches on the way.
There were some great moments in the film.
This job needs some special tools.
He made some really bad choices.
Il y a quelques bons restaurants ici.
These are some new ideas for the team.
She told some truly funny stories.
We met some different people abroad.
quiet: We saw very old churches on the way.
There were great moments in the film.
Il y a de bons restaurants ici.
These are new ideas for the team.

predictions: The word after 'some' fires. The same adjective without 'some' stays quiet, which makes the near misses very close.
